commits_data.title: ssh: add decryption for chacha20-poly1305@openssh.com
commits_data.message:
ssh: add decryption for chacha20-poly1305@openssh.com

Decrypt SSH sessions using the chacha20-poly1305@openssh.com cipher
Note: This cipher follows this draft, which has one key
difference from RFC 7539 (the draft uses an 8 byte nonce and 8 byte
counter while RFC 7539 uses a 12 byte nonce and 4 byte counter)
https://tools.ietf.org/html/draft-josefsson-ssh-chacha20-poly1305-openssh-00

Bug: 16054

commits_data.message:
ssh decryption: load logged keys and compute symmetric keys

Load private key exchange keys (curve25519-sha256) provided by the user
Find matching public keys in the dissected data
Compute symmetric keys for decrypting encrypted Transport Layer Protocol
